summary: Focused-key delivery measured for fenix6 on 8.4.1, 9.1.0.

method.measurement: Task 0/5 family probe: real FocusedKeyTransport, simulator control through the installed signed server.
method.deliveryEvidence: fixture FIXTURE_KEY markers read through get_logs with an advancing cursor
method.presses: enter, esc, up, down, plus a 1000ms hold of up, per SDK

menu.reason: fenix 6/7/8 have no menu key; menu is a long press of up. Withdrawn family-wide by the 2026-08-03 delivery amendment.

transportFacts.note: The dwell floor, the inert first-key warm-up and the activation route are properties of the transport, not of the device. They were not re-measured per device; this contract records only what this device's probe actually observed.
